name: Personal Data Protection Law (Georgia)
law: Law of Georgia on Personal Data Protection No. 3144 of 14 June 2023, in force 1 March 2024, as amended

deadline.text: 10 working days from the request, extendable by up to 10 further working days in special cases with immediate notice to you. Decisions on blocking must be notified within 3 working days.
deadline.citation: Articles 13(2), 14-16 and 20 of the Law on Personal Data Protection

GE.name: State Audit Office of Georgia (supervisory body named in the consolidated law; the former Personal Data Protection Service functions)

cite.en: Articles 13 and 14 of the Law of Georgia on Personal Data Protection

text.en: Please confirm whether you process my personal data and provide me with the information set out in Article 13, including the purposes, sources, recipients and storage periods, together with a copy of my data under Article 14.

cite.en: Article 15 of the Law of Georgia on Personal Data Protection

text.en: Please correct, update and complete the inaccurate or incomplete personal data you hold about me, as specified in this request, and notify the recipients of the data of the change.

cite.en: Article 16 of the Law of Georgia on Personal Data Protection

text.en: Please stop processing my personal data and erase or destroy it, and confirm in writing once this has been done.

cite.en: Article 18 of the Law of Georgia on Personal Data Protection

text.en: Please provide the personal data that I supplied to you, which you process by automated means on the basis of consent or a contract, in a structured, machine-readable format or transmit it to another controller where technically feasible.

cite.en: Article 20 of the Law of Georgia on Personal Data Protection

text.en: I hereby withdraw my consent to the processing of my personal data. Please stop processing, erase or destroy my data where no other legal ground applies, and confirm in writing.

sources.title: Law of Georgia on Personal Data Protection (consolidated, matsne.gov.ge)

notes: Articles 13-16, 18 and 20 and the 10-working-day deadlines were read from the consolidated English text on matsne.gov.ge (only the first ~100k of 179k characters were reviewed). The consolidated text names the State Audit Office as the supervisory body in Arts 22, 28-30 but also mentions the 'Personal Data Protection Service' in Art. 29(9); the regulator's current name and website (sao.ge) are unverified. No stand-alone general right to object (only direct marketing, Art. 12(4)), so objection is omitted. Deadline is in working days, hence days is null.
